manifesto.title: A caterer and a decorator, under one name.
manifesto.text: At Sud Events, food and decoration are designed together. The colours of the room answer the dishes, the centrepieces leave room for the platters, and one team looks after everything, from set-up to the last course. On the day, you have a single contact, and everything fits.

items.name: Catering
items.text: Carved fruit buffets, composed salads, verrines, petits fours, tiered cakes and dishes served at the table by our waiters.

items.name: Decoration
items.text: White flower arches, candelabras, candles, the couple's throne and signs with your names: the room takes on your colours.

items.name: Equipment hire
items.text: Chairs, linen, gold tableware, candelabras, arches and stands, to hire on their own or with our services.

traiteur.title: A generous table, designed like a set
traiteur.text: Our buffets are seen before they are tasted: carved fruit, dishes under silver cloches, a veil of smoke as the platters arrive. Oriental and Southern cooking, savoury and sweet, we build the menu with you around your guests and the way you like to entertain.

specialties.name: Fruit buffets
specialties.text: Fresh fruit, carved and cascading, for a colourful finale.

specialties.name: Savoury buffets
specialties.text: Composed salads, seafood pastillas, pastries, mini pizzas and pasta.

specialties.name: Verrines & petits fours
specialties.text: Verrines, tartlets, macarons, brownies and sweet bites.

specialties.name: Tiered & celebration cakes
specialties.text: Tiered cakes and celebration cakes, brought out at the high point of the evening.

specialties.name: Dishes served at the table
specialties.text: Chicken with olives and almonds, tagines and slow-cooked dishes served under cloches.

specialties.name: Waiting staff
specialties.text: A team on the floor for table service, the arrival of the platters and the buffet.

service.title: Service, on the floor
service.text: Our waiters carry the dishes to the tables, under silver cloches or in a cloud of smoke, and look after the buffet until the last guest.

sweet.title: The sweet table
sweet.text: Red berry brownies, macarons, verrines, tartlets: the dessert buffet is laid out like a shop window.

formulas.title: Three ways to entertain
formulas.text: Each package adapts to your number of guests and your menu. Your quote is tailored to your event.

cocktail.name: Cocktail
cocktail.text: For a reception drink, an engagement or a standing party.

buffet.name: Buffet
buffet.text: A grand buffet, savoury and sweet, where everyone helps themselves.

servi.name: Served dinner
servi.text: The full meal served at the table by our waiters, from starter to dessert.

detail.title: Every detail counts
detail.text: A folded napkin, a candle, gold cutlery, a crystal glass: it is the whole that makes the table.

decoration.title: A room in your image, from floor to ceiling
decoration.text: We dress the whole reception room: draping, white flower arches, centrepieces, gold or crystal candelabras, candles and light. Oriental, mixed or more classic, we start from your colours and your story.
decoration.oriental: Oriental and mixed weddings: the couple's throne, entrance carpet, silver cloches, and lighting designed for every big moment of the night.

reviews.title: In the couples' words
reviews.source: Review from a couple, shared on our Instagram
reviews.translation: A huge thank you to the Sud Event team for turning our wedding into a real fairy tale! The decoration was absolutely sublime, every detail perfectly thought out and carried out. […] Your professionalism is remarkable: responsive, available, attentive, and above all incredibly accommodating. […] You are much more than a simple supplier, you are true artists […] I recommend Sud Event with my eyes closed.

partners.title: Our partners
partners.text: Suppliers we often meet at our weddings, to complete your day.

zone.title: Across the South, from Provence to Hérault
zone.text: We cater and decorate weddings and events in the Vaucluse, Bouches-du-Rhône and Hérault, in reception halls, estates or outdoors. Your venue is elsewhere? Ask us.

items.q: Do you work in my town?
items.a: We work in the Vaucluse (84), Bouches-du-Rhône (13) and Hérault (34): Avignon, Carpentras, Orange, Marseille, Aix-en-Provence, Arles, Montpellier, Béziers and the surrounding areas. For another venue, just ask.

items.q: Can we book catering and decoration together?
items.a: Yes, it is our favourite way to work: one team for the food, the service and the decoration, with a single quote. You can also book just one of the two.

items.q: Can we hire equipment without a service?
items.a: Yes. Chairs, linen, tableware, candelabras, arches and stands can be hired on their own. Add items to your request from our hire catalogue.
Yes, many of our weddings are Oriental or mixed: dishes served under cloches, fruit buffets, the couple's throne, entrance carpet. We build the menu and the decoration with you.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Fill in the quote form: date, venue, number of guests and tables, the service you need. Your request reaches us on WhatsApp and we come back to you with a proposal.

quote.title: Tell us about your event
quote.text: A few details are enough to prepare your quote: the date, the venue, the number of tables to decorate and the service you need. Your request reaches us directly on WhatsApp.
